skills.skill_desc:
Hanabi's Basic Attacks and skills launch <font color="a6aafb">Petal Blades</font> upon hitting a target, dealing 30% damage and bouncing up to 4 times to nearby enemies. <font color="a6aafb">Petal Blades</font> launched by Basic Attacks inherit Attack Effects.
If bounces from the same Basic Attack or skill hit the same target multiple times, subsequent bounces deal 30% less damage.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Whenever Hanabi has a shield from any source, she is immune to control effects.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Hanabi gains a 300<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield for 5s. When the shield is active, she gains 20% Movement Speed and 25% Attack Speed, and 20% of her damage dealt to enemy heroes is added to this shield (only 10% of the damage dealt to non-hero units is added). This shield cannot exceed 50% of her <font color="26e407"><1005></font>.

Hanabi fires the energy Kunai in the targeted direction, dealing 350<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way and reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 1s. Enemy units hit will also be marked, allowing Hanabi's next Bounce Damage from Basic Attacks to deal 30<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> on them with no damage decay.

Hanabi throws Higanbana in the targeted direction, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8s. After 1s, Higanbana will bloom at the location of the first hit, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target decay to 30% damage.
